definition: One element of the set on which the design is built; here one candidate marker (v = 26 for WINGMEN, 20 for Levine-32).
caution: Marker-to-point assignment is a labelling (seed-0 mapping).

definition: A k-subset of points; here the candidate markers measured together in one tube.
caution: Each tube also carries the 8 backbone markers, which are not design points.

definition: Number of candidate markers per tube (k = 6 in the follow-up designs).
caution: Backbone counted separately: 6 candidates + 8 backbone = 14 channels per tube.

definition: Size of the point set (26 WINGMEN, 20 Levine-32 reliable non-backbone markers).
caution: Unreliable markers are not candidates.

definition: A set of t candidate markers (a 3-marker set). It becomes a joint phenotype only when a positive/negative pattern is specified; a 3-marker set has 2^3 = 8 patterns.
caution: The design covers marker sets, not patterns.

cytometry_term: number of tubes containing the marker set
definition: Count of tubes whose candidate markers include all t markers (the number of direct co-measurements of the set).
caution: Not a cell count and not the number of times a precision target is met.

cytometry_term: tube set measuring every t-marker set at least once
definition: A family of k-subsets such that every t-subset lies in at least one block (lambda >= 1).
caution: Says nothing about cell numbers per tube.

definition: The covering number is the minimum number of blocks; a verified covering with b blocks is a feasible upper bound b.
caution: A feasible upper bound is not a proven minimum.

cytometry_term: 130-tube design measuring every 3-marker set exactly once
definition: Covering with lambda = 1 for every triple; meets the lower bound, so 130 is optimal for C(26,6,3).
caution: Classical design; not one of the improved cells.

definition: S(3,6,26) realised on GF(25) with 'circles' as blocks.
caution: Coordinates are an assigned labelling, not marker biology.

cytometry_term: tubes left usable after gating on a marker x
definition: Blocks through x minus x: a 2-(25,5,1) design (30 lines); inside x+ cells only collinear triples are co-measured (300/2300).
caution: Coverage fraction, not detection sensitivity.

cytometry_term: 125-tube design with one marker from each of 5 families
definition: Every cross-family triple appears in exactly one tube (RS[5,3] codebook).
caution: The 5 families are an artificial constraint.

cytometry_term: every 3-marker set in at least two tubes
definition: Covering in which every triple lies in >= 2 blocks; v = 20, k = 6 tested at 141 blocks (N1).
caution: No certificate found does not prove impossibility.

definition: Eight markers present in all tubes, used for parent gates and micro-strata.
caution: Not design points; not counted in k.

definition: Cells passing a positive/negative backbone gate (e.g. CD4T, B).
caution: Parents may overlap and must not be summed.

cytometry_term: cells measured on all three markers
definition: Parent cells in a tube containing the whole 3-marker set; their pattern counts give the direct estimate.
caution: A zero count still yields an interval.

cytometry_term: bounds from every observed event margin
definition: Confidence bounds of a joint frequency implied by every observed event margin of the claim markers (each measured sub-pattern, including the full pattern where a direct tube exists), each within its Clopper-Pearson 95% interval, Bonferroni-corrected within the claim; the identification bounds fix the same margins at their EM-fit values without sampling allowance.
caution: Can be wide; same-source replay only.

definition: Exact interval for one pattern frequency.
caution: Per pattern (marginal), not a joint 95% region over the 8 patterns.

definition: Half the CP interval width, maximised over the 8 patterns of the set.
caution: Marginal per pattern.

definition: claim_goal.epsilon = 0.02 of the main protocols.
caution: Distinct from replay tolerances and epsilon_d.

definition: Tolerance used in mechanism replays (0.03-0.08); not the protocol epsilon. The e5b tolerances were chosen post hoc (freeze README).
caution: Not a protocol endpoint; selection timing per module in S7/Experiments (epsilon_selection).

definition: 1.1 x the per-donor planning scale in the per-donor replay.
caution: Exploratory.

definition: Target counts as attained if its half-width <= the tolerance; reported as the fraction of all targets.
caution: Uncovered targets count as not attained.

definition: Maximum over the 8 patterns of |tube estimate - reference frequency| <= the tolerance.
caution: The reference split has its own sampling error.

definition: resolved: direct witness and direct CP half-width <= protocol epsilon; resolved_and_ref_overlap (field 'correct'): resolved and the direct interval intersects the reference interval.
caution: Not an accuracy.

definition: 20% of cells with all markers measured; source of reference frequencies.
caution: Not ground truth.

definition: design seed, initial replicate, cell allocation, optimizer seed, shuffle and frep index different random draws of the same data.
caution: Not biological replicates.

cytometry_term: successive rounds of the computational covering search
definition: Labels of the search rounds that produced the improved upper bounds.
caution: Search provenance: see Methods.
